question:
What should come in the place of question mark (?) in the following alpha numeric series?

2A-50, 5Z-46, 8B-42, 11Y-38, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b2c5feae0b612b62dabd6fc426a1ed65e1b5ee3656bf36eed8c2c481baceeed.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Here is the detailed explanation for the pattern:

 
• First Number: The series starts with 2 and increases by 3 in each consecutive step. Thus, the next number is 11 + 3 = 14.
 
• Letter: There are two alternate series of letters.
 
 
• Series 1: A, B, C... (+1)
 
• Series 2: Z, Y, X... (-1)
 
 The next letter in the sequence will be the next letter of the first series, which is C.
 
• Second Number: The series starts with 50 and decreases by 4 in each consecutive step.
 
• Thus, the next number is 38 - 4 = 34.

By combining the results, the missing term is 14C-34.
